facts.fact: AIM reports the minister said the National CSIRT Network already has operational teams in government, the Cyber Defence Unit, MoRENet, INCM, telecoms and four provinces.
AIM reports critical information infrastructure sectors identified as energy, telecoms, transport, health, finance and public security, with their protection part of the measures.

note: Date inferred from weekday (article 8 Oct, 'esta quarta-feira'); strategy 2026-2030 only being updated; no incident or figures.
